task.question: Can a cutoff-safe five-line candidate bank preserve source provenance while removing duplicate and near-duplicate lines?
task.novelty: Target-specific bank combines frozen B and E025 survivors, merges lines with at least five shared numbers, and retains every source and training cutoff.

spec.research_question: Can a cutoff-safe five-line candidate bank preserve source provenance while removing duplicate and near-duplicate lines?
spec.training_cutoff_rule: Each candidate line comes from a B cached forecast or E025 signal forecast with training cutoff t-1; target outcomes are not read during bank construction.
spec.primary_metric: candidate-bank validity, provenance completeness, and pairwise overlap after deduplication
spec.comparator: pre-dedup B and E025 source candidates on the same target
spec.baseline: Merge candidates when intersection count >=5; retain highest frozen score as canonical and preserve all aliases.
spec.tie_break: higher source score, then source model name; candidate ID follows target/source order
spec.novelty_signature: target-specific provenance bank; five-number-intersection near-duplicate merge; frozen B plus E025/E026 independent survivors
